backup_region.description: Region in which backup is stored.

backup_vault_type.description: Type of the backup vault to be created. Default is IN_REGION. Possible values: ["BACKUP_VAULT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "IN_REGION", "CROSS_REGION"]

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: An optional description of this resource.

kms_config.description:
Specifies the Key Management System (KMS) configuration to be used for
backup encryption. Format:
'projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/kmsConfigs/{{kms_config}}'

labels.description:
Labels as key value pairs. Example: '{ "owner": "Bob", "department": "finance", "purpose": "testing" }'.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

name.description: The resource name of the backup vault. Needs to be unique per location.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

backup_retention_policy.description: Backup retention policy defining the retention of the backups.

backup_retention_policy.backup_minimum_e.description: Minimum retention duration in days for backups in the backup vault.

backup_retention_policy.daily_backup_imm.description: Indicates if the daily backups are immutable. At least one of daily_backup_immutable, weekly_backup_immutable, monthly_backup_immutable and manual_backup_immutable must be true.

backup_retention_policy.manual_backup_im.description: Indicates if the manual backups are immutable. At least one of daily_backup_immutable, weekly_backup_immutable, monthly_backup_immutable and manual_backup_immutable must be true.

backup_retention_policy.monthly_backup_i.description: Indicates if the monthly backups are immutable. At least one of daily_backup_immutable, weekly_backup_immutable, monthly_backup_immutable and manual_backup_immutable must be true.

backup_retention_policy.weekly_backup_im.description: Indicates if the weekly backups are immutable. At least one of daily_backup_immutable, weekly_backup_immutable, monthly_backup_immutable and manual_backup_immutable must be true.
